## ***Bangladesh High Commission, Colombo, Sri Lanka***

\

***Address***

No. 3, Srimath R.G. Senanayake Mawatha,

Colombo-07, Sri Lanka.

\

***Telephone***

+94-11 -2695-744, 2695-748

\

***Fax***

+94-11 -2695-556

\

***E-mail***

[mission.colombo@mofa.gov.bd](mailto:mission.colombo@mofa.gov.bd)\

\

***Office time***

0900 to 1700 hrs. (Monday to Friday)

\

***Weekly Holidays***

Saturday and Sunday
